title: nbn FTTP or HFC 750/50 $60/Month for 6 Months (New Customers) @ Spintel
body:
Deal: nbn FTTP or HFC 750/50 $60/Month for 6 Months (New Customers) @ Spintel

[askbargain] I had to port out after a billing issue and talking to their support is like talking to a useless AI chatbot. You're probably better off with amaysim for same price and free dynamic ipv4.
[ruddiger7] Yep just came to Amaysim after my 6 months with these guys ran out. No issues so far
[sunaus] amaysim deal is better, and spintel customer support not good either.
But spintel dynamic IPv4 $2pm looks like sticky, and IPv6 working as well.
[CRCinAU] Yeah - having native IPv6 is great. No more NAT or port forwarding - even from mobiles now - as they mostly have IPv6 too…
[Grange Hermit] I was already on their (Spintel's) 500 / 50 for $58 deal, signed up for this despite being existing customer, order being processed.
I'm happy with IPv6, a 'sticky' IPv4, and no CGNAT. Had a couple of IPv6 issues, which was a problem their end, now fixed. CSR's were ok in my dealings with them.
[Mypdaygone] Is there a time period where you could be considered a new customer again? Had spintel for a little bit but had to churn out as found better offer elsewhere.
[shxhshzhz] Amaysim NBN750 $60 for 6 months with no CGNAT and no extra fee
[valkeris] How you get $94.95 ongoing. Says $100 on the website for the 750plan.
[backupper1] just add approximately $2 to the amount because they have no way of payment that doesn’t involve a payment processing fees of around $2 and its not very clear at the start. The CC is highly technical but the billing is their achilles heel.
[GGGGrrrrr] Card surcharges are not illegal yet, but a complete ban by the Reserve Bank of Australia takes effect on October 1, 2026 for EFTPOS, Visa, and Mastercard transactions. Until then, businesses can still charge surcharges as long as they do not exceed the actual cost of processing the payment
[Cousin IT] Just to clarify, they do have a payment option with no fees, Direct Debit from your account.
It's even in the OP's info.
[jwh] I’ve never seen surcharges stated like that before. It’s also illegal to advertise prices as ‘plus GST’ for consumer facing products, they need to advertise the full increase on those surcharges. May even look a bit like drip pricing.
So will it be for example, 1.1% inc GST of the surcharge, with the first surcharge?
[hollykryten] I had a look at Spintel while ISP browsing a few months ago but i went with Launtel instead and it's been great. Paid the $100 for the lifetime static IPv4 IP address with no CG-NAT. And i get blatantly fast download speed in Steam. I was able to get their discount for 6 months offer. I suppose you get what you pay for.
[CRCinAU] $100 once off for an IP address? Damn…
I guess if you're with then for 2 years, then it can start to save you money vs the per month other ISPs charge, but its a bit of a customer lockin at that point :|
[Twix] You get the $100 back when you leave. Alternatively you pay Launtel an extra 15c a day.
[CRCinAU] oh, its like a deposit? That's even weirder lol
[Twix] @CRCinAU: Yeah $100 deposit. Launtel also give you the $100 back if you no longer need the Static IP.
[Schrodinger] @Twix: That's pretty reasonable for a static IP. I'll give this a try.
[harithoz] Just got 500/60 yesterday for $65. Anyone reached to them for a free upgrade?
[Morien] Anything to know about before hand?
Pro rata refunds?
Cancellation policies?
[crazypanda] i had spintel for 6 months, it random drops out 10 sec some nights
[deed03] Anyone know the turn around of fttc to fttp these days?
[SetTheFaqUp] not sure whether it is from here or my friends/relo. i m paying $65/month for 500/50 after discount. cant be f-d churning.
used spintel for many years, and been happy. and give codes for $5 off makes it worthwhile.
[davidl222222] 1 month notice + use Optus backhaul for international route?
[Xcwizit] Is anyone on spintel and can confirm steady 750mb speeds between 7pm-11pm?
[nerftheprice] I'm currently with Spinel but signed up for Dodo, will be connected next month. Connection drops and rarely get the expected speed (FFTP). Wouldn't recommend.
